detail.body:
- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?
Sum the gradient of the GatedDeltaNet output norm weight across tensor-parallel ranks when sequence parallelism is off, so every TP rank gets the same, full-head gradient for this replicated weight.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: Fixes #8317

Companion issue in Megatron-Bridge: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/issues/6533

### Cause

`self.out_norm` in `_GDNBase.__init__` (`megatron/core/ssm/gated_delta_net/common.py`) has `hidden_size=value_head_dim` and is replicated on every TP rank, while the value heads it scales are split across TP ranks. Each rank's backward therefore only accumulates the gradient contribution of its own heads. `_allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads` sums a replicated weight across TP only when it is marked `sequence_parallel` (and SP is on) or is a `q_layernorm`/`k_layernorm` by name. With SP off the GDN `out_norm` matches neither, so each TP rank applies a different partial gradient and the replicated copies drift apart. The loss and the global grad norm do not show it.

### Fix

- `common.py`: when `tp_size > 1` and sequence parallelism is off, mark the `out_norm` parameters with `sum_gradients_across_tp_domain = True` (the sum counterpart of the existing `average_gradients_across_tp_domain`).
- `finalize_model_grads.py`: `_allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads` also SUM-reduces params carrying that marker, in the same branch as the sequence-parallel and qk_layernorm cases.

`GatedDeltaNet` and `GatedDeltaNet2` both build `out_norm` in the shared base class, so both are covered. `GatedDeltaProduct`'s gated norm is built over the local `d_inner` slice and marked `tensor_model_parallel`, so it does not have this problem. With SP on nothing changes (the param was already summed through the `sequence_parallel` path, and it is not marked). The reduction runs at the same point and on the same `main_grad` buffers as the existing SP layernorm reduction, so the distributed-optimizer, overlapped grad reduce and Megatron-FSDP branches are handled the same way they already are for SP layernorms.

### Test

New `test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp` in `tests/unit_tests/ssm/test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py`, parametrized over variant (`gated_delta_net`, `gdn2`), TP 2/4 and SP off/on. It builds one GDN layer from the module spec, wraps it in megatron-core DDP, runs forward/backward on the same input on every rank, records each rank's partial `out_norm` `main_grad`, calls `finalize_model_grads`, and asserts that the result is bitwise identical across TP ranks and equal to the sum of the partials over the TP group (averaged over DP).

Run with `torchrun --nproc_per_node 8 -m pytest` on 8x B200 (torch 2.14.1, Transformer Engine 2.18.0, flash-linear-attention 0.4.2; the GDN2 cases skip because this FLA version has no GDN2 support):

Before the fix (main):
```
PASSED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[2-True-gated_delta_net]
PASSED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[4-True-gated_delta_net]
FAILED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[2-False-gated_delta_net]
FAILED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[4-False-gated_delta_net]
E   AssertionError: out_norm main_grad differs between TP rank 0 and TP rank 1
2 failed, 2 passed, 4 skipped
```

After the fix:
```
PASSED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[2-False-gated_delta_net]
PASSED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[2-True-gated_delta_net]
PASSED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[4-False-gated_delta_net]
PASSED test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py::test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp[4-True-gated_delta_net]
4 passed, 4 skipped
```

Existing tests, same environment, before and after the fix:

| file | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `distributed/test_finalize_model_grads.py` | 12 passed | 12 passed |
| `ssm/test_gated_delta_net_parallel.py` (incl. the new test) | 2 failed (the new SP-off cases), 12 passed, 18 skipped | 14 passed, 18 skipped |
| `ssm/test_gated_delta_net.py` | 6 failed, 77 passed, 56 skipped | 6 failed, 77 passed, 56 skipped |
| `ssm/test_gated_delta_net_recompute.py` | 6 failed, 6 skipped | 6 failed, 6 skipped |
| `ssm/test_gated_delta_net_padding.py` | 4 passed, 8 skipped | 4 passed, 8 skipped |
| `ssm/test_gated_delta_net2.py`, `ssm/test_gated_delta_net2_parallel.py` | all skipped (no GDN2 in FLA 0.4.2) | all skipped |

The 6 failures in `test_gated_delta_net.py` and `test_gated_delta_net_recompute.py` are the same `test_selective_recompute_norm_out` cases on main and with this PR. They fail in my environment because a JIT C++ extension cannot be built (`RuntimeError: Ninja is required to load C++ extensions`), not because of this change. The tests ran on main at 65ac821; the branch is rebased onto 1effc75, whose one extra commit does not touch these files.

Formatting: black 26.3.0 (`--skip-magic-trailing-comma --skip-string-normalization`), isort 5.13.2, ruff 0.9 and pylint 3.2.6 (10.00/10) report no changes or issues on the changed files.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md)) (not applicable: no kernel change)
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR (ran its black/isort/ruff/pylint commands directly on the changed files, see above)

files.patch:
@@ -463,9 +463,9 @@ def _allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads(
     tp_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup] = None,
 ):
     """
-    All-reduce both layernorm grads (for sequence parallelism) and
-    gradients from modules with average_gradients_across_tp_domain=True
-    across tensor-model-parallel ranks.
+    All-reduce layernorm grads (for sequence parallelism), gradients of params with
+    sum_gradients_across_tp_domain=True, and gradients from modules with
+    average_gradients_across_tp_domain=True across tensor-model-parallel ranks.
     """
     tp_group = get_tensor_model_parallel_group_if_none(tp_group)
     if tp_group.size() <= 1:
@@ -492,9 +492,12 @@ def _allreduce_non_tensor_model_parallel_grads(
                     else:
                         grad = _unshard_if_dtensor(grad)
                         grads_avg.append(grad.data)
-                # Check if this param needs sum reduction (sequence parallel or qk_layernorm)
-                elif (config.sequence_parallel and getattr(param, "sequence_parallel", False)) or (
-                    config.qk_layernorm and ("q_layernorm" in name or "k_layernorm" in name)
+                # Check if this param needs sum reduction (sequence parallel, qk_layernorm, or
+                # a replicated param whose grad is a per-rank partial sum)
+                elif (
+                    (config.sequence_parallel and getattr(param, "sequence_parallel", False))
+                    or (config.qk_layernorm and ("q_layernorm" in name or "k_layernorm" in name))
+                    or getattr(param, "sum_gradients_across_tp_domain", False)
                 ):
                     grad_attr = _get_main_grad_attr(param)
                     grad = getattr(param, grad_attr)

@@ -301,6 +301,12 @@ def __init__(
             hidden_size=self.value_head_dim,
             eps=self.config.layernorm_epsilon,
         )
+        # The out_norm weight is replicated on every TP rank but scales TP-split value heads,
+        # so each rank's backward only accumulates the gradient of its own heads. Without
+        # sequence parallelism nothing else sums it across TP; mark it for that sum.
+        if self.tp_size > 1 and not self.config.sequence_parallel:
+            for param in self.out_norm.parameters():
+                setattr(param, "sum_gradients_across_tp_domain", True)
         self.recompute_norm_out = False
         self.norm_out_checkpoint = None
         if self.config.recompute_granularity == "selective":

@@ -5,10 +5,17 @@
 import torch.nn.functional as F
 
 from megatron.core import parallel_state
+from megatron.core.distributed import (
+    DistributedDataParallel,
+    DistributedDataParallelConfig,
+    finalize_model_grads,
+)
 from megatron.core.models.gpt.experimental_attention_variant_module_specs import (
+    get_experimental_attention_variant_module_spec,
     get_transformer_block_with_experimental_attention_variant_spec,
 )
-from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net import HAVE_FLA
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net import HAVE_FLA, HAVE_FLA_GDN2
 from megatron.core.ssm.gated_delta_net.common import (
     _build_head_perm_for_split_sections,
     _build_thd_cp_a2a_perm,
@@ -81,6 +88,104 @@ def test_parallel_gated_delta_net_correctness(
     )
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("variant", ["gated_delta_net", "gdn2"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("tp", "sp"), [(2, False), (4, False), (2, True), (4, True)])
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not HAVE_FLA, reason="FLA is not installed.")
+def test_gdn_out_norm_grad_is_summed_across_tp(variant, tp, sp):
+    """The replicated out_norm weight must get the full-head gradient on every TP rank.
+
+    Each TP rank owns a slice of the value heads that out_norm scales, so its backward only
+    accumulates a partial gradient. After finalize_model_grads, the gradient must be the sum of
+    the partials over the TP group, identical on every TP rank, with and without sequence
+    parallelism.
+    """
+    if variant == "gdn2" and not HAVE_FLA_GDN2:
+        pytest.skip("FLA with GDN2 support is not installed.")
+    if Utils.world_size % tp != 0:
+        pytest.skip(f"world size {Utils.world_size} is not divisible by tp={tp}")
+
+    Utils.initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=tp)
+    try:
+        torch.manual_seed(123)
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(123)
+        tp_group = parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_group()
+        dp_group = parallel_state.get_data_parallel_group()
+        config = TransformerConfig(
+            hidden_size=128,
+            linear_conv_kernel_dim=2,
+            linear_key_head_dim=32,
+            linear_value_head_dim=32,
+            linear_num_key_heads=4,
+            linear_num_value_heads=8,
+            num_layers=1,
+            normalization="RMSNorm",
+            use_cpu_initialization=True,
+            num_attention_heads=8,
+            activation_func=F.silu,
+            bf16=True,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=tp,
+            sequence_parallel=sp,
+            experimental_attention_variant=variant,
+            linear_attention_freq=[1],
+            transformer_impl="transformer_engine",
+        )
+        gdn_spec = get_experimental_attention_variant_module_spec(config=config)
+        gdn = gdn_spec.module(
+            config,
+            submodules=gdn_spec.submodules,
+            layer_number=1,
+            pg_collection=ProcessGroupCollection(
+                tp=tp_group, cp=parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group()
+            ),
+        ).cuda()
+        model = DistributedDataParallel(
+            config, DistributedDataParallelConfig(grad_reduce_in_fp32=True), gdn
+        )
+
+        # The same full-sequence input and loss weights on every rank.
+        seq_length, micro_batch_size = 64, 2
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        shape = (seq_length, micro_batch_size, config.hidden_size)
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        loss_weights = torch.randn(shape, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        if sp:
+            local_seq_length = seq_length // tp
+            local_slice = slice(
+                tp_group.rank() * local_seq_length, (tp_group.rank() + 1) * local_seq_length
+            )
+            hidden_states = hidden_states[local_slice]
+            loss_weights = loss_weights[local_slice]
+
+        model.zero_grad_buffer()
+        output, _ = model(hidden_states.requires_grad_(), attention_mask=None)
+        (output.float() * loss_weights.float()).sum().backward()
+
+        params = list(gdn.out_norm.parameters())
+        assert params, "out_norm has no parameters"
+        # Before finalize_model_grads, main_grad holds this rank's partial (own-heads) gradient.
+        expected = []
+        for param in params:
+            grad = param.main_grad.detach().clone()
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(grad, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.SUM, group=tp_group)
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(grad, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.AVG, group=dp_group)
+            expected.append(grad)
+
+        finalize_model_grads([model])
+
+        for param, expected_grad in zip(params, expected):
+            grad = param.main_grad.detach()
+            gathered = [torch.empty_like(grad) for _ in range(tp)]
+            torch.distributed.all_gather(gathered, grad.contiguous(), group=tp_group)
+            for rank, other in enumerate(gathered):
+                assert torch.equal(
+                    other, gathered[0]
+                ), f"out_norm main_grad differs between TP rank 0 and TP rank {rank}"
+            torch.testing.assert_close(grad, expected_grad)
+    finally:
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("cp_size", [2, 4], scope="class")
 @pytest.mark.internal
 @pytest.mark.skip(
